bioconda.name: psspd
bioconda.summary: Pipeline for strain-specific primer design from genome and CDS sequences
bioconda.description:
PSSPD is an offline pipeline that designs strain-specific primer sets from
genome and coding sequences. Given genome and CDS sequences for a target
strain and the strains it is compared against, it reports primers that
amplify genic regions of the target strain only.

The pipeline runs BLASTP to find genes of the target strain that have no
homolog in the compared strains, confirms their specificity against the
compared genomes with GMAP, designs primers on the remaining genes with
Primer3, and checks the specificity of the primers and their amplicons
against all genomes with BLASTN.

The pipeline runs in the current working directory, so results are written
where it is invoked rather than into the installation.
